items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: I used to play every Sunday at Lincoln Park for Buddy Boulder.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you ever go up around Betsy Coles? Oh, yeah.
I used to play every Sunday at Lincoln Park for Buddy Boulder. Oh, yeah? The balloon used to go up. Used to send the balloon up. We played on the inside at night for the dance.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Oh, yeah, Buddy Bolden's band. You played with him? Sure, I played with Jimmy, sure, and Jimmy.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear Bolden's band, that's one year?

Oh, yeah, Buddy Bolden's band. You played with him? Sure, I played with Jimmy, sure, and Jimmy. Jimmy used to work in some, uh, factory, you know. Factory, yeah. See? Bunch of factory. That's right. And lots of time, you know, he'd be late if he couldn't make it, and I used to pitch it for him. Yeah. He was playing at a hall on Padilla and Liberty called, uh, Kenny's Hall. Oh, yeah. You remember that, Kenny's Hall? That's a good one. I don't know.
I used to call it funky butthole. That's it.
